description: Control of round 7d (a normal call is an opaque frontier): head adds an `it.each` table whose rows hold `'skip'` and `'only'` as data. The table is an argument of the call `it.each(…)`: the callee of the use `it.each([…])('upper %s', …)` is read without the arguments of the calls it holds (only by-name accesses — getattr, Reflect.get, subscripts — are transparent), and `each` is not a token: no finding. The real runner runs every row.
